info.name: OGC API Processes tests
info.description: Generated from the repository's canonical case.json and request.json files. Do not edit this collection by hand.

request.description:
Calculate the boundary of the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixture.

Canonical source: cases/boundary_polygon

Buffer the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the published GeoJSON fixture. Uses a small distance in longitude/latitude coordinate units rather than the advertised default of 10.

Canonical source: cases/buffer_polygon

Calculate the centroid of the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixture.

Canonical source: cases/centroid_polygon

Test whether the Alkmaar polygon contains an interior point

Uses pinned GML references with the polygon as InputEntity1 and its interior point as InputEntity2.

Canonical source: cases/contains_polygon_point

Calculate the convex hull of the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixture.

Canonical source: cases/convex_hull_polygon

Create a Delaunay triangulation from five Alkmaar points

Reference-input case pinned to the published five-point GML 3.1 fixture.

Canonical source: cases/delaunay_five_points

Start the deliberately failing demo process asynchronously

The initial execution request creates a job. The provider is designed to fail later; status polling will be a separate test.

Canonical source: cases/demo_async_expected_failure

Subtract one overlapping Alkmaar polygon from another

Direction-sensitive reference-input case using the pinned simple polygon as InputEntity1.

Canonical source: cases/difference_polygons

Calculate the distance between two Alkmaar polygons

Uses pinned polygon GML references. Although the process describes generic geometries, this provider's parser rejects point GML and explicitly extracts only Polygon or MultiPolygon; the overlapping fixtures produce distance zero.

Canonical source: cases/distance_polygons

Echo literal, JSON, and bounding-box inputs

Exercises the three optional input and output shapes advertised by EchoProcess.

Canonical source: cases/echo_all_input_kinds

Capture the failR provider-level error

Expected-error case: the R provider deliberately reports service failure.

Canonical source: cases/fail_r_expected_error

Create contours from the small Alkmaar DEM

Local-profile case. This provider uses paths directly and writes an ESRI Shapefile dataset below ZOO tmpPath.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_contour_dem

Calculate slope from the small Alkmaar DEM

Local-profile case. This provider uses paths directly, so the request names the staged dataPath input and tmpPath output explicitly. Hillshade is not used because the implementation requires an unadvertised z input.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_dem_slope

Extract an elevation profile along the Alkmaar line

Local-profile case. RasterFile is relative to ZOO dataPath; Geometry uses the commit-pinned public GeoJSON line reference.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_extract_profile_line

Grid the five Alkmaar elevation points

Expected-error local-profile case. The advertised inputs reach the provider, but it returns 500 without a useful message because its implementation needs unadvertised layer/band parameters. The request intentionally does not invent them.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_grid_points

Translate the small Alkmaar DEM

Local-profile case. Stage fixtures with scripts/stage_zoo_fixtures.py; InputDSN is relative to ZOO dataPath and OutputDSN is created below tmpPath.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_translate_raster

Warp the small Alkmaar DEM

Local-profile case. Stage fixtures first; the DEM is reprojected from OGC CRS84 to EPSG:3857 and written below ZOO tmpPath.

Canonical source: cases/gdal_warp_raster

Calculate the area of the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the GML 3.1 fixture. The result is in square coordinate units unless the service reprojects.

Canonical source: cases/get_area_polygon

Execute hellojs with a string input

Basic literal-input smoke test.

Canonical source: cases/hellojs_string

Intersect two overlapping Alkmaar polygons

Both required reference inputs are pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixtures.

Canonical source: cases/intersection_polygons

Validate the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the explicitly closed GML fixture and intended to produce true.

Canonical source: cases/is_valid_polygon

Start longProcess asynchronously

Verifies asynchronous job creation. Job polling and dismissal will be separate cases.

Canonical source: cases/long_process_async

Convert the Alkmaar polygon vector dataset

Local-profile case. Stage fixtures first; InputDSN is relative to dataPath and the GeoJSON output is created below tmpPath.

Canonical source: cases/ogr2ogr_vector

Add two Alkmaar raster inputs with OTB BandMath

Exercises the advertised repeated image list and overlapping out input/output ID. The same fixture and expression run with OTB CLI 7.0; ZOO reports an empty OTB application registry.

Canonical source: cases/otb_band_math

Compute statistics for two Alkmaar raster inputs

Exercises an advertised repeated image list and requests XML inline. The same images run with OTB CLI 7.0; ZOO reports an empty OTB application registry.

Canonical source: cases/otb_compute_image_statistics

Read one pixel from the Alkmaar DEM

The GeoTIFF and parameters run successfully with OTB CLI 7.0. ZOO fails before reading them because its OTB application registry is empty.

Canonical source: cases/otb_pixel_value

Rasterize the Alkmaar polygon with OTB

Uses referenced GeoJSON and an inline support image. Both mode-specific inputs are included because the description marks both required. The data run with OTB CLI 7.0; ZOO reports an empty OTB application registry.

Canonical source: cases/otb_rasterization

Segment the Alkmaar DEM to a raster with OTB

Selects raster mode but includes all branch-specific inputs marked required by the description. Direct OTB CLI execution succeeds; ZOO reports an empty OTB application registry before reading the request data.

Canonical source: cases/otb_segmentation

Add Alkmaar DEM values to point features

Combines a referenced vector with the required raster list input.

Canonical source: cases/saga_add_grid_values_points

Create contour lines and polygons from the Alkmaar DEM

Exercises two vector outputs from one raster input.

Canonical source: cases/saga_contours_raster

Create an empty two-field SAGA table

Retains the observed metadata anomaly: this table output is advertised with raster media types.

Canonical source: cases/saga_create_table

Dissolve two adjacent Alkmaar polygons

Uses an inline GeoJSON fixture and exercises Boolean dissolve options without the anomalous generated field-selector input.

Canonical source: cases/saga_dissolve_polygons

Apply a Gaussian filter to the Alkmaar DEM

SAGA 7.3 provider-profile case using a referenced AAIGrid input.

Canonical source: cases/saga_gaussian_filter

Multiply an Alkmaar raster with the SAGA grid calculator

A single referenced AAIGrid succeeds. Supplying two advertised repeated GRIDS values crashes this provider; see saga_grid_calculator_repeated_input_expected_error.

Canonical source: cases/saga_grid_calculator

Calculate with two rasters (provider crash evidence)

Both GRIDS values and the g1 + g2 expression conform to the advertised schema. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGSEGV.

Canonical source: cases/saga_grid_calculator_repeated_input_expected_error

Interpolate the Alkmaar elevation points to a raster

The request follows the advertised schema using point Z values and a user-defined grid. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGSEGV.

Canonical source: cases/saga_idw_points

Intersect two Alkmaar polygon layers with SAGA

The request follows the advertised schema using two referenced vector inputs and a JSON Boolean. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGABRT.

Canonical source: cases/saga_intersect_polygons

Join two small Alkmaar CSV tables

Uses inline UTF-8 CSV tables and defaults to their first fields as join identifiers.

Canonical source: cases/saga_join_tables

Split an Alkmaar line by a polygon

Exercises two vector inputs and the process's intersection and difference outputs.

Canonical source: cases/saga_line_polygon_intersection

Mosaic one Alkmaar raster

A single referenced AAIGrid succeeds. Supplying two advertised repeated GRIDS values crashes this provider; see saga_mosaic_rasters_repeated_input_expected_error.

Canonical source: cases/saga_mosaic_rasters

Mosaic two rasters (provider crash evidence)

Both GRIDS values conform to the advertised repeated raster schema. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGSEGV.

Canonical source: cases/saga_mosaic_rasters_repeated_input_expected_error

Convert five LAS points to small rasters

The request follows the advertised schema using an inline base64 LAS 1.2 fixture. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGSEGV.

Canonical source: cases/saga_pointcloud_to_grid

Resample one Alkmaar raster to a user-defined grid

A single referenced AAIGrid succeeds. Supplying two advertised repeated INPUT values crashes this provider; see saga_resample_rasters_repeated_input_expected_error.

Canonical source: cases/saga_resample_rasters

Resample two rasters (provider crash evidence)

Both INPUT values conform to the advertised repeated raster schema. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGSEGV.

Canonical source: cases/saga_resample_rasters_repeated_input_expected_error

Convert five Alkmaar points to TIN-derived shapes

Requests all five advertised vector outputs from the 3D point fixture.

Canonical source: cases/saga_shapes_to_tin

Create Thiessen polygons from five Alkmaar points

The request follows the advertised schema using referenced GeoJSON points. The tested provider reproducibly terminates with SIGABRT.

Canonical source: cases/saga_thiessen_points

Split the Alkmaar DEM into small tiles

Uses the cell-count tiling method and a repeated raster output.

Canonical source: cases/saga_tile_raster

Build a TIN from Alkmaar points and export its shapes

The ZOO SAGA adapter advertises vector representations for TIN and internally converts the supplied shapes to a TIN.

Canonical source: cases/saga_tin_to_shapes

Calculate DEM statistics for three Alkmaar raster zones

Combines an inline base64 zone grid with a referenced statistics grid and requests CSV output.

Canonical source: cases/saga_zonal_statistics

Simplify the simple Alkmaar polygon

Reference-input case pinned to the published GeoJSON fixture. Uses a tolerance appropriate to longitude/latitude coordinate units.

Canonical source: cases/simplify_polygon

Calculate the symmetric difference of two Alkmaar polygons

Both required reference inputs are pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixtures.

Canonical source: cases/symmetric_difference_polygons

Union two overlapping Alkmaar polygons

Both required reference inputs are pinned to the published GML 3.1 fixtures.

Canonical source: cases/union_polygons

item.name: GET_process_description_cases
item.description: Explicit cases for process-description endpoint behaviour.

request.description:
Capture the ReadImageInfo description crash

GET of the advertised process description terminates zoo_loader.cgi with SIGSEGV before an execution request can be constructed. The GeoTIFF succeeds with otbcli_ReadImageInfo but is diagnostic only and is not sent by this GET case.

Canonical source: cases/otb_read_image_info_description_expected_error
